text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian newspapers this morning.
-An opinion poll shows falling support for the ruling Labour Party. Support fell by 6.3 percent from December to January, but the opposition Centre Party made gains.
-Norwegian authorities want more women in leading positions. Currently only two out of 15 ministries have the same number of men and women in top jobs.
-Norway's largest savings bank, Union Bank of Norway, will reduce staff by 450 persons in order to cut costs.
-Norway's Aker Maritime has entered an agreement to buy 80 percent of U.S.-based Lazer Inc. for 56 million crowns. Lazer Inc. is an offshore company operating in the Mexican Gulf.

-Norwegian Brokerhouse Fiba Nordic Securities says in a recent analysis that the value of offshore company Awilco is underestimated. Fiba expects the share price to rise by 40 percent in the first six months of 1997.
